placeholders.player_name_spelled: The confirmed profile name with spaces between letters, for Mimicry's confirmation line.

syrus.source: base portrait exists; expression frames required

E01.b01_arrival_01.speaker: narrator
E01.b01_arrival_01.text: The ferry horn fades behind you. Ahead, Duel Academy rises out of the morning mist, all white stone and red roofs.

E01.b01_arrival_02.speaker: player
E01.b01_arrival_02.text: So this is Duel Academy. Okay. First day. Don't screw it up.

E01.b01_arrival_03.speaker: narrator
E01.b01_arrival_03.text: A bell rings across the plaza. Upperclassmen wave the new students toward the gym.

E01.b01_arrival_04.speaker: player
E01.b01_arrival_04.text: The opening assembly. Right. Let's go.

E01.b02_sheppard_01.speaker: sheppard
E01.b02_sheppard_01.text: Welcome, everyone. I am Chancellor Sheppard, and this is Duel Academy.

E01.b02_sheppard_02.speaker: sheppard
E01.b02_sheppard_02.text: You came here to become duelists. Some of you will become champions. All of you will learn what it feels like to lose.

E01.b02_syrus_01.speaker: syrus
E01.b02_syrus_01.text: J-Jaden, not so loud. Everyone's looking...

E01.b02_chumley_01.speaker: chumley
E01.b02_chumley_01.text: Wake me up when the dueling starts.

E01.b02_sheppard_03.speaker: sheppard
E01.b02_sheppard_03.text: Duel Academy is not only about winning. You will study rules, card lore, strategy, and the history of the game.

E01.b02_sheppard_04.speaker: sheppard
E01.b02_sheppard_04.text: A duel, like life, is not over until the very end. There is always a combo that opens new possibilities. Remember that.

E01.b02_sheppard_05.speaker: sheppard
E01.b02_sheppard_05.text: Registration is at the reception desk in the academy lobby. Professor Mimicry is waiting. After that, report to your dorm headmaster.

E01.b02_sheppard_06.speaker: sheppard
E01.b02_sheppard_06.text: One more thing. A duel is a conversation. Listen to your opponent. Respect your deck. And never forget why you play.

E01.b02_sheppard_07.speaker: sheppard
E01.b02_sheppard_07.text: That is the spirit. Welcome to Duel Academy!

E01.b03_mimicry_01.speaker: mimicry
E01.b03_mimicry_01.text: Ah! A new face. Welcome, welcome! I am Professor Mimicry. Practical dueling, exam coordination, and a little of everything else.

E01.b03_mimicry_02.speaker: mimicry
E01.b03_mimicry_02.text: First, your name. Spell it out for me, one letter at a time. I will write it exactly as you say it.

E01.b03_name_prompt.speaker: mimicry
E01.b03_name_prompt.text: Go on. One letter at a time. Press END when you are finished.

input.note: GBA manual: the player may enter a name of up to eight letters; END confirms.

E01.b03_name_confirm_prompt.speaker: mimicry
E01.b03_name_confirm_prompt.text: Let me make sure I have it. {player_name_spelled}. That is {player_name}, yes?

choices.text: No - let me spell it again.

E01.b03_mimicry_04.speaker: mimicry
E01.b03_mimicry_04.text: {player_name}! A fine name. It will look good on the exam roster. Or terrible, if you do not study. We will see!

E01.b03_mimicry_05.speaker: mimicry
E01.b03_mimicry_05.text: Here is your student PDA. Map, calendar, deck, mail, save - everything you need. Try not to lose it. The replacement fee is 500 DP.

E01.b03_mimicry_07.speaker: mimicry
E01.b03_mimicry_07.text: Registration complete. Your dorm is Slifer Red - next to the bridge leading to the harbor. Your orientation continues there. Good luck!

E01.b03_mimicry_08.speaker: mimicry
E01.b03_mimicry_08.text: Oh, and the card shop opens next Saturday. Miss Dorothy has been unpacking boxes all week. Basic packs, 100 DP. Save your DP until then.

E01.b03_player_01.speaker: player
E01.b03_player_01.text: Got it. Slifer Red. Thank you, Professor.

E01.b03_mimicry_09.speaker: mimicry
E01.b03_mimicry_09.text: Do not thank me yet. Wait until you see the exams.

E01.b04_narrator_01.speaker: narrator
E01.b04_narrator_01.text: The west path ends at a creaky red building perched above the ocean. The sign reads SLIFER RED DORM.

E01.b04_jaden_01.speaker: jaden
E01.b04_jaden_01.text: Hey! You must be the new Slifer. I'm Jaden. This is Syrus, and that's Chumley.

E01.b04_syrus_01.speaker: syrus
E01.b04_syrus_01.text: H-hi. I'm Syrus. Welcome to Slifer Red. It's... not much, but it's home.

E01.b04_chumley_01.speaker: chumley
E01.b04_chumley_01.text: Chumley Huffington. If you're hungry, the cafeteria is this way. Priorities.

E01.b04_player_01.speaker: player
E01.b04_player_01.text: Nice to meet you all. I'm {player_name}.

E01.b04_jaden_02.speaker: jaden
E01.b04_jaden_02.text: Professor Banner is inside. He's got your starting DP and probably a lecture. Come on!

E01.b05_banner_01.speaker: banner
E01.b05_banner_01.text: Ah, our new student! Welcome. I am Lyman Banner, head of Slifer Red. I teach alchemy, and I keep an eye on this lot.

E01.b05_banner_08.speaker: banner
E01.b05_banner_08.text: Duel Academy has three levels: Slifer Red, Ra Yellow, and Obelisk Blue. Your entrance exam placed you here in Slifer Red with us.

E01.b05_banner_09.speaker: banner
E01.b05_banner_09.text: Every month there is an exam. Score well and you can change levels. You also carry a duelist title. The top rank is King of Games.

E01.b05_jaden_04.speaker: jaden
E01.b05_jaden_04.text: I'm going to be King of Games! Just you watch.

E01.b05_banner_10.speaker: banner
E01.b05_banner_10.text: And this little buddy is Pharaoh. He has been with me since my alchemy days.

E01.b05_banner_02.speaker: banner
E01.b05_banner_02.text: Before we eat, business. Every new student receives a starting budget of 3,000 DP.

E01.b05_banner_03.speaker: banner
E01.b05_banner_03.text: DP - Duelist Points. You earn them by dueling. You spend them at the card shop on booster packs. A pack costs 100 to 200 DP, depending on the set.

E01.b05_syrus_02.speaker: syrus
E01.b05_syrus_02.text: The shop opens next Saturday. Miss Dorothy has been unpacking boxes all week.

E01.b05_chumley_02.speaker: chumley
E01.b05_chumley_02.text: I'm saving for a Master Fusions pack. Or lunch. Probably lunch.

E01.b05_banner_04.speaker: banner
E01.b05_banner_04.text: Spend wisely. A bigger deck is not always a better deck. And do not blow it all on one pack.

E01.b05_jaden_03.speaker: jaden
E01.b05_jaden_03.text: Or do! Pack opening is the best part!

E01.b05_banner_06.speaker: banner
E01.b05_banner_06.text: You can reach these three through your PDA mail. They are good people. Mostly.

E01.b05_syrus_03.speaker: syrus
E01.b05_syrus_03.text: I can show you the basics of dueling after this. If you want.

E01.b05_banner_07.speaker: banner
E01.b05_banner_07.text: Good. Syrus, do not let them leave until they know a summon from a set.

E01.b06_syrus_01.speaker: syrus
E01.b06_syrus_01.text: Okay! First, the absolute basics. Your deck has 40 to 60 cards. You start with 8,000 Life Points.

E01.b06_syrus_02.speaker: syrus
E01.b06_syrus_02.text: Each turn you draw one card. You can Normal Summon or Set one monster. Level 4 or lower needs no tribute. Level 5 or 6 needs one tribute. Level 7 or higher needs two.

E01.b06_syrus_03.speaker: syrus
E01.b06_syrus_03.text: Monsters in Attack Position battle with ATK. Monsters in Defense Position protect with DEF. Destroyed monsters go to the Graveyard.

E01.b06_syrus_04.speaker: syrus
E01.b06_syrus_04.text: Spell Cards do things right away. Trap Cards must be Set first, then activated later - usually on your opponent's turn.

E01.b06_syrus_05.speaker: syrus
E01.b06_syrus_05.text: To win, reduce your opponent's Life Points to zero. If they cannot draw a card, they lose too.

E01.b06_syrus_06.speaker: syrus
E01.b06_syrus_06.text: Let's try it. I've set up a practice duel. No DP on the line, no story stuff - just a few turns so you can see how it feels.

E01.b06_tutorial_ready.speaker: syrus
E01.b06_tutorial_ready.text: Ready to give it a try?

choices.text: Can you explain the phases again?

E01.b06_syrus_phases.speaker: syrus
E01.b06_syrus_phases.text: Draw, Standby, Main, Battle, End. In Main you summon and set. In Battle you attack. That's the short version.

E01.b06_syrus_duel_start.speaker: syrus
E01.b06_syrus_duel_start.text: Here we go! Remember: summon a monster, set a card if you have one, then attack when the lane is clear.

E01.b06_syrus_win_01.speaker: syrus
E01.b06_syrus_win_01.text: You did it! See? Summon, set, battle. That's the whole game.

E01.b06_player_win_01.speaker: player
E01.b06_player_win_01.text: That was fun. I think I'm getting it.

E01.b06_syrus_win_02.speaker: syrus
E01.b06_syrus_win_02.text: You're a natural. Jaden is going to want a duel next.

E01.b06_syrus_loss_01.speaker: syrus
E01.b06_syrus_loss_01.text: Don't worry! Losing is part of learning. You lasted longer than my first practice duel.

E01.b06_syrus_loss_02.speaker: syrus
E01.b06_syrus_loss_02.text: That's the spirit! Want to run it back, or keep exploring?

E01.b06_syrus_loss_ok.speaker: syrus
E01.b06_syrus_loss_ok.text: All right! You know where to find me. And remember: a practice loss doesn't count against you.

E01b.b07_narrator_01.speaker: narrator
E01b.b07_narrator_01.text: A week of orientation, class schedules, and cafeteria curry later...

E01b.b07_player_01.speaker: player
E01b.b07_player_01.text: Saturday. Finally. No classes. The card shop opens today.

E01b.b07_pda_01.speaker: pda
E01b.b07_pda_01.text: NEW OBJECTIVE: Explore Duel Academy. The Card Shop is open. Save your progress from the PDA at any time.

E01b.b07_dorothy_01.speaker: dorothy
E01b.b07_dorothy_01.text: CARD SHOP: OPEN. Basic packs 100 DP. - Miss Dorothy

E01b.b07_narrator_02.speaker: narrator
E01b.b07_narrator_02.text: Outside your window, the island is waking up. The gym, the harbor, the dorm roofs - all yours to explore.

E01b.b07_free_roam_01.speaker: player
E01b.b07_free_roam_01.text: All right. Let's see what this island has to offer.

E01b.b07_free_roam_02.speaker: pda
E01b.b07_free_roam_02.text: Tip: Jaden is waiting outside the dorm. He's always up for a duel.

FJ01.b08_jaden_01.speaker: jaden
FJ01.b08_jaden_01.text: Hey, {player_name}! Syrus says you survived his tutorial. How did it go?

FJ01.b08_player_01.speaker: player
FJ01.b08_player_01.text: Pretty good. I think I'm getting the hang of it.

FJ01.b08_jaden_02.speaker: jaden
FJ01.b08_jaden_02.text: Then you're ready for a real duel. No story, no pressure - just you and me. What do you say?

FJ01.b08_jaden_decline_01.speaker: jaden
FJ01.b08_jaden_decline_01.text: No worries! I'll be here. The dorm, the beach, wherever. Come find me when you're ready.

FJ01.b08_jaden_win_01.speaker: jaden
FJ01.b08_jaden_win_01.text: Whoa! That was awesome! You've got game, {player_name}.

FJ01.b08_player_win_01.speaker: player
FJ01.b08_player_win_01.text: That was a great duel. Thanks, Jaden.

FJ01.b08_jaden_win_02.speaker: jaden
FJ01.b08_jaden_win_02.text: Come back anytime. I want a rematch.

FJ01.b08_jaden_loss_01.speaker: jaden
FJ01.b08_jaden_loss_01.text: Good duel! You've got the basics down. Keep at it.

FJ01.b08_jaden_loss_02.speaker: jaden
FJ01.b08_jaden_loss_02.text: That's what dorm-mates are for. Now go get some curry before Chumley eats it all.

E01.b01_starter_choice.speaker: mimicry
E01.b01_starter_choice.text: Before you register, choose the starter deck you will bring to Duel Academy.
